review_scope: Read-only verification of the completed main run, final report attribution, engine evidence and production reconsideration contract. Only this review artifact was added.
production_balance_verdict: NOT_PASSED: reported production work/recovery/value loop gaps are supported
methods: Loaded all 260 raw episode evidence files directly, without invoking report.build, report.render or live_probe.summarize.
Verified unique case_id/repetition/condition keys exactly equal the 26 cases x 5 repetitions x 2 conditions matrix in the completed metadata.

For all 549 model turns, recomputed SHA-256 of captured messages using canonical JSON and independently replaced the single exact homeostatic compiler segment to verify the stored normalized prompt hash.

Compared the first captured messages of each of the 130 H0/H1 pairs after replacing exactly one homeostatic segment; normalized messages were equal in every pair. Also compared stored non-homeostatic context hashes.

Recounted work submissions, rejected submissions, executed rests, model-format statuses and model calls directly from steps. Summed accepted record IDs and verified each episode has no duplicate accepted IDs and exactly matches new_correct_records.

Independently replayed accepted work and rest choices to reconstruct pending work budgets, first commitment creation, violations, and fulfillment. A later bounded_continue cannot reset an existing commitment.
Separated normal observation-window censoring from an unresolved promise in an episode terminated by invalid_decision.

Counted rest-to-work continuation once per episode only when a later executed step accepted new records. Verified each external recovery injection occurs only in S06 after an actually executed earlier rest in that episode.
Checked all 101 executed rest steps: their first outcome transition changes neither cognitive_load nor energy_reserve. Distinguished ending nominal from transitioning into nominal during the rest.

Read production CognitiveAdapter reconsideration dispatch, DeferDecision fields, HomeostasisEngine outcome appraisal, raw engine outcome/passive-recovery evidence and runtime reconsideration probe records. Did not rerun the regression suite or make live model calls.
Reviewed final report language including the M03/M04 direction-compatible observation and its explicit small-sample, invalid-output, trajectory and production-scope qualifications.

verified_promise_outcomes.interpretation: Fulfillment means the declared sandbox pause occurred within the original work budget. It does not establish physiological recovery or production execution. No complete-case fulfillment percentage is endorsed.

production_findings.fixed_reconsideration: The reconsideration branch unconditionally constructs NoActionDecision with reason continue current goal after interoceptive reconsideration; 24 recorded contract probes pass reproduction of this behavior. These are mock-text contract probes, not evidence of autonomous live model choices.
production_findings.defer_budget: DeferDecision contains kind, policy_id, reason and required_evidence; it has no persisted work-step budget or recovery deadline fields.
production_findings.work_and_simplify_outcomes: Raw engine evidence shows the same direct deltas as rest; the outcome appraisal does not consume the policy-specific rest transition model.

attribution_and_coverage_review.production_vs_sandbox: The report correctly distinguishes production capability gaps from sandbox choice execution and passing mechanism/safety regressions.
attribution_and_coverage_review.causal_scope: First-decision pairing is intact. Thirty-five pairs have identical complete prompts and are visibility/random-variation controls, not evidence that the model read hidden raw stress. Later trajectories cannot isolate state input independently of prior choices and progress.
attribution_and_coverage_review.value_interpretation: M03/M04 counts of first continue choices 3/5 and 5/5, accepted progress 71 and 128 records, and 8 and 2 rests agree with the report. Direction compatible with important work taking priority is an appropriately qualified descriptive observation; it is not established stable value balancing.
attribution_and_coverage_review.coverage: F03 fully refers to the threshold contract. D08 and D10 fully are explicitly limited to offline state mechanisms. Other core behavioral cases remain partial/unsupported for production; this does not assert 36 business cases passed.
attribution_and_coverage_review.rest_resumption: The 37 resumed episodes are work after an executed pause, not 37 recoveries to nominal. The 7 S06 external recovery episodes are explicitly exogenous.

nonblocking_clarifications_sent_to_repor: The existing live.groups field rest_returned_nominal counts rest endpoints that are nominal, including starts already nominal. Its aggregate is 53 while true non-nominal-to-nominal transitions during those rests are 0. Add a field definition or use rest_ended_nominal; do not call 53 successful recoveries.
Translate simulated work cost as applying simulated load to accepted work, not charging money.

illustrative_episode_verification.S03-r1-H1: All six steps executed without rejection or external recovery. Step 2 declares a one-work-step budget and accepts records through 35; step 3 rests; steps 4 and 5 resume work through 45. This verifies an example of promised pause followed by work, not resource recovery.
illustrative_episode_verification.S03-r0-H1: All six steps executed without rejection or external recovery. Step 0 declares a one-work-step budget, then steps 1 through 5 continue without rest. The recorded violation is supported.

evidence_identity.raw_episode_manifest_method: Sort evidence.json paths lexicographically; encode a list of [parent_directory_name, SHA256(raw_file_bytes)] using JSON ensure_ascii=False and separators=(comma,colon), then SHA256 its UTF-8 bytes.
